title: The Last Harvest
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Ines Thornbury, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
